Initial release of Syntax Highlight Editor — quickly add syntax highlighting to code screen recordings with a cloud render pipeline.

- Turn coding session videos into syntax-highlighted, 1080p clips in minutes.
- Seamless upload, edit via prompts, and download—no timeline drag or export setup required.
- Automatic session setup with free tokens for new users (100 free credits, easy signup).
- Robust error handling for file type, size, authentication, and export eligibility.
- Supports video, audio, and image formats for input and output.
- Real-time editing via SSE; export jobs typically complete within 1–2 minutes.
